# Lipik

> Free, open-source (MIT) voice dictation for Mac. Hold fn, speak, let go: clean text is typed in any app. Speech to text and clean-up run on the Mac; no account, no word limit.

## Facts

- Platform: macOS, Apple silicon (M1 or later)
- Price: free. Licence: MIT
- Speech model: Parakeet Unified English 0.6B by default (one-time 731 MB download); free Whisper models cover 99 languages; Hinglish in beta
- Clean-up: optional and built in (runs on the Mac through llama.cpp, no extra app); one button in setup or Settings → Meetings downloads Qwen3 8B (5 GB) on Macs with 16 GB of memory or more, or Qwen3 4B Instruct (2.5 GB) on smaller Macs, from Hugging Face; meeting summaries and Ask use it too; needs macOS 13.3 or later (older Macs use Ollama); Ollama stays an optional advanced choice in Settings; without a clean-up model, built-in rules still fix "um", spoken punctuation, numbers, times and emails
- Features: tone per app, dictionary, snippets, hands-free (fn + Space), meeting notes with a summary, AI apps can read meeting notes through MCP, works with Wi-Fi off once the models are downloaded
- Meeting notes speakers: the mic is the user; the call audio is split into Speaker 1, Speaker 2 and so on, or names when there's clear evidence (they introduce themselves or are addressed by name); clicking a speaker's name renames them everywhere in that meeting, and Lipik recognises that voice in later meetings; saved voices stay on the Mac, are removed with their meeting, and can all be forgotten in Settings → Privacy; one-time 33 MB speaker model; calls over 3 hours keep a single "Them"
- Network: one-time downloads from Hugging Face (speech model 731 MB, clean-up model 2.5 or 5 GB, speaker model 33 MB); Apple's English (India) speech files through macOS, for Hinglish only; once a day a request to GitHub for the latest version number, to show a "new version" notice (carries nothing about the user; can be turned off in Settings → Privacy → Updates); cloud clean-up only if the user adds their own API key; every 3 hours an anonymous usage count to lipik.refflux.dev (random install ID, app version, macOS version, country worked out by Cloudflare with the IP address not kept; never voice, text or names; can be turned off in Settings → Privacy → Usage count); an email only if the user types one during setup; no account

## Links

- Install: paste `curl -fsSL https://lipik.refflux.dev/install.sh | sh` into Terminal (downloads the latest release into Applications, no macOS security warning), or download the .dmg
- Download: https://github.com/Gourav2609/lipik/releases/latest/download/Lipik.dmg
- Code: https://github.com/Gourav2609/lipik
- Release notes: https://lipik.refflux.dev/releases
- Pricing: https://lipik.refflux.dev/pricing
- Hinglish voice typing (beta): https://lipik.refflux.dev/hinglish
- Meeting notes without a bot: https://lipik.refflux.dev/meeting-notes
- Free local dictation for Mac: https://lipik.refflux.dev/free-dictation-mac
